actors.name: Kestrel Analytics support team members
actors.private_context: Each team member has their own morale level, job satisfaction, and personal expectations about the upcoming reorg. They have heard rumors but lack official details.

actors.name: Kestrel Analytics management
actors.private_context: Management has decided on a reorg plan that will affect the support team. They have not yet communicated the details to the team. They believe the reorg will improve efficiency but are uncertain about morale impact.

shared_context: Kestrel Analytics is a company with a support team. A reorganization (reorg) is planned and will be announced to the support team on 2026-09-01. The reorg may involve changes to roles, reporting lines, or team structure. The team's morale after the reorg is the subject of interest.

starting_events.description: Management announces the reorg details to the support team.

resolution: Resolve YES if, by the hard cutoff, the persistent event history shows that a majority of support team members have expressed (in any observable form, such as survey responses, public statements, or documented feedback) that their morale is better than before the reorg. Otherwise resolve NO.
